svg.title: A Blitz file: a body of raw float32 vectors, a footer with each row's position, byte offset and binary-quantized bits, and an eight-byte footer offset at the end. Reading takes three steps: read the tail and footer (cached), compute Hamming distances in memory to keep the closest K, then issue ranged reads for only those K full vectors and rerank them exactly. Each file returns its own top K, merged in a final step.
svg.text: body: raw float32 vectors, 4d bytes each
read the tail, then the footer
in memory, keep the closest K
ranged reads for those K vectors only
sorted, merged, in parallel; exact rerank
each file returns its own top K; one last step merges them

figure.figcaption: The footer decides; the body only answers for the few rows the footer picked.
